entity.name: USGS PAGER (Prompt Assessment of Global Earthquakes for Response)

lineage.description: Earthquake locations and magnitudes are continuously collected by the USGS seismic monitoring network. Ground motion shakemaps are generated using the PAGER program methodology, which models seismic wave propagation and converts instrumental data into intensity measures for rapid hazard assessment and emergency response.
